versions.changelog:
arxiv-html-cn-static v1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for converting arXiv experimental HTML papers into local Chinese static HTML webpages.
- Preserves local images, figures, icons, CSS, all paper metadata, and section structure.
- Integrates with arxiv-paper-resolver for Chinese Markdown extraction; wraps this content as HTML.
- Includes scripts to fetch, localize, and bundle assets into an offline-ready directory.
- Maintains all figures and tables in original layout, formatted for optimal reading and local access.
- Output directory contains index.html, localized assets, PDF, and metadata files.
